name: Claude Code
d: Anthropic's coding agent for the terminal and IDE.

name: Codex CLI
d: OpenAI's coding agent for the terminal.

name: Gemini CLI
d: Google's open-source agent for the terminal.

name: MCP specification
d: The protocol itself.

name: Playwright
d: Lets the AI drive a real browser: click, type, read pages, take screenshots.
plain: Lets your AI open websites, click buttons, fill forms and take screenshots for you.
useFor: Check a web page and grab a screenshot
Fill out the same online form many times
Collect prices or details from several sites
steps: Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config.
Restart your app so it loads the new server.
Ask in plain words, for example: open example.com and take a screenshot.

name: Chrome DevTools
d: Debug a live Chrome: console, network, performance traces.
plain: Lets your AI look inside a Chrome page to find why it is slow or broken.
useFor: Find the error behind a broken web page
See why a page loads slowly
Check which requests a page sends and receives
steps: Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet. You also need Google Chrome.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config.
Restart your app so it loads the new server.
Ask, for example: open my site in Chrome and tell me why it loads slowly.

name: Context7
d: Feeds up-to-date library docs to the AI so it stops using outdated APIs.
plain: Gives your AI the latest instructions for software tools so its code examples are current.
useFor: Get code that matches the newest version of a tool
Ask how a feature works in a specific library
Avoid fixes that rely on outdated instructions
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http context7 https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
Mention the tool you use, for example: using Context7, show how to set up Next.js routing.

name: GitHub
d: Read and manage repos, issues, pull requests and Actions.
auth: GitHub login (OAuth) or a personal access token
plain: Lets your AI read and manage your GitHub projects, issues and pull requests.
useFor: Summarize open issues in a project
Create an issue from a bug description
Review what changed in a pull request
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
Sign in with GitHub when asked, or use a personal access token if your app requires one.
Ask, for example: list the open issues in my repo and group them by topic.

name: Notion
d: Search, read and write your Notion workspace.
plain: Lets your AI search, read and write pages in your Notion workspace.
useFor: Find a note or page without digging through Notion
Turn meeting notes into a new Notion page
Update a task list or database in Notion
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
Sign in to your account when the app asks, and allow access.
Ask, for example: find my notes from last week's planning meeting and summarize them.

name: Supabase
d: Query and manage your Supabase database, tables and migrations.
plain: Lets your AI look at and change your Supabase database for you.
useFor: Ask questions about the data in your tables
Create or change a table for your app
Check what changes were made to your database
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http supabase https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp
Sign in to your account when the app asks, and allow access.
Ask, for example: how many users signed up last week?

name: Sentry
d: Pull real production errors into the AI and fix them.
plain: Lets your AI read the real errors your live app reports to Sentry and help fix them.
useFor: List the most common errors in your app this week
Get an explanation of one error in plain words
Find the code behind an error and suggest a fix
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
Sign in to your account when the app asks, and allow access.
Ask, for example: what are the top errors in my project today?

name: Exa Search
d: Web search built for AI agents.
plain: Gives your AI a web search tool so it can find current pages and facts.
useFor: Find recent articles on a topic
Look up companies or people for background research
Collect sources with links for a report
steps: In claude.ai go to Customize > Connectors > Add custom connector and paste https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http exa https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
Ask, for example: search the web for recent news about electric bikes and list sources.

name: Firecrawl
d: Scrape and crawl websites into clean text.
plain: Lets your AI read whole websites and turn their pages into clean text.
useFor: Pull the text of a long article without ads
Collect every page of a small website
Gather product details from several pages at once
steps: Create a Firecrawl account and copy your API key.
Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config. Paste your key where it says FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
Restart your app, then ask, for example: read example.com and summarize every page.

name: Figma (Framelink)
d: Give the AI your Figma layouts so it can build them in code.
plain: Lets your AI see your Figma designs so it can turn them into a working page.
useFor: Turn a Figma screen into a web page
Match colors and spacing exactly to your design
Ask questions about a layout's structure
steps: In Figma, create a personal access token and copy it.
Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config. Paste your token where it says YOUR-KEY.
Restart your app, paste a Figma link, and ask it to build that screen.

name: Filesystem
d: Read and write files in folders you allow. Great first server to try.
plain: Lets your AI read and save files in folders on your computer that you choose.
useFor: Summarize every document in a folder
Rename or sort files by a rule you describe
Search your notes for a specific topic
steps: Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config. Put your folder in place of /path/to/folder.
Restart your app so it loads the new server.
Ask, for example: list the files in my folder and summarize the newest one.

name: Memory
d: A simple knowledge graph so the AI remembers facts between chats.
plain: Lets your AI remember facts about you and your work from one chat to the next.
useFor: Save your preferences so you do not repeat them
Keep track of people and projects across chats
Ask what it remembers about a topic
steps: Install Node.js from nodejs.org if it is not on your computer yet.
Open the MCP setup page on this site, pick your app, and copy the config.
Restart your app so it loads the new server.
Tell it what to remember, for example: remember that my team meets on Mondays.

name: docx
d: Create and edit Word documents with formatting, tables and comments.
plain: Lets Claude create and edit Word documents with proper formatting, tables and comments.
useFor: Turn rough notes into a formatted Word report
Add a table or comments to an existing document
Fill a Word template with new details
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: make a Word report from these notes.

name: xlsx
d: Excel: formulas, tables, charts, data analysis.
plain: Lets Claude build and edit Excel files with formulas, charts and tidy tables.
useFor: Turn a messy list into a clean spreadsheet
Add formulas and totals to a budget
Make a chart from sales numbers
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: make an Excel budget with monthly totals and a chart.

name: pptx
d: PowerPoint decks from scratch or from a template.
plain: Lets Claude make PowerPoint slide decks, from scratch or from your own template.
useFor: Turn a document into a short slide deck
Build slides using your company template
Update numbers and text in an existing deck
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: make a 10-slide deck from this report.

name: pdf
d: Read, fill forms, merge and split PDFs.
plain: Lets Claude read PDFs, fill in PDF forms, and merge or split PDF files.
useFor: Fill in a PDF form from your details
Combine several PDFs into one file
Pull tables or text out of a PDF
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: merge these three PDFs into one file.

name: doc-coauthoring
d: Write a document together with you, section by section.
plain: Claude writes a document with you step by step, asking questions and drafting each section.
useFor: Draft a proposal together, one section at a time
Write a project plan with guided questions
Improve a draft so a reader follows it easily
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: help me write a project proposal, section by section.

name: frontend-design
d: Sites and UIs that don't look like generic AI output.
plain: Helps Claude design websites and screens that look distinctive instead of generic.
useFor: Design a landing page for a small business
Give an existing page a fresh, less generic look
Mock up an app screen to share with others
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: design a landing page for my bakery with a bold, warm style.

name: canvas-design
d: Posters and visual pieces as PNG/PDF.
plain: Lets Claude create posters and other visual pieces as image or PDF files.
useFor: Make a poster for an event
Create a simple visual for a presentation
Design a printable flyer as a PDF
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: make a poster for our office summer party as a PDF.

name: theme-factory
d: Ready-made color and font themes for docs and slides.
plain: Applies ready-made color and font styles to your documents and slides.
useFor: Give a slide deck a consistent look
Try several color styles on one document
Match a report's style to a presentation
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: apply a modern theme to this slide deck.

name: brand-guidelines
d: Applies brand colors and fonts. A template for your own brand.
plain: Applies set brand colors and fonts to what Claude makes; you can copy it for your own brand.
useFor: Keep slides and documents in your brand colors
Make a custom skill with your own brand rules
Check a draft against your brand style
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app. The built-in version uses Anthropic's brand.
For your own brand, copy it, change the colors and fonts, and zip the folder.
Upload the .zip in Claude under Settings > Capabilities > Skills, then ask for on-brand slides.

name: web-artifacts-builder
d: Richer web apps (React, Tailwind) bundled into one HTML file.
plain: Lets Claude build richer interactive web tools that fit in a single file you can share.
useFor: Build a small calculator or tracker app
Make an interactive dashboard from your data
Create a quiz or form to share
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: build a simple habit tracker app I can open in a browser.

name: webapp-testing
d: Tests a web app in a real browser with Playwright.
plain: Lets Claude test your web app in a real browser and report what breaks.
useFor: Check that the sign-up page of your app works
Take screenshots of your app while it runs
Find buttons or links that do not work
steps: In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Open Claude Code in the folder of the app you want to test.
Just ask in plain words, for example: test my app's login page in a browser and tell me what fails.

name: mcp-builder
d: Builds MCP servers that connect AI to your own systems.
plain: Helps Claude build your own connector so AI can use your company's systems.
useFor: Connect AI to an in-house tool or database
Turn an existing web API into an AI connector
Plan which actions your connector should offer
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: help me build an MCP server for our inventory system's API.

name: skill-creator
d: A skill that makes skills. Start here for your own.
plain: Helps you make your own skill, a saved set of instructions Claude follows for a task.
useFor: Save how you like weekly reports written
Turn a repeated checklist into a reusable skill
Improve a skill you already made
steps: On a paid Claude plan this skill is already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills, then /plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Just ask in plain words, for example: help me create a skill for writing our weekly team update.
Upload the finished .zip in Claude under Settings > Capabilities > Skills.

name: UI UX Pro Max
d: Design intelligence: styles, palettes, font pairings, UX rules. This site was designed with it.
plain: Gives your AI design knowledge: styles, color palettes, font pairs and usability rules.
useFor: Pick colors and fonts for a new website
Get a design style that suits your business type
Check a page against common usability rules
steps: In Claude Code run /plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
Then run /plugin install ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill
For other apps, run npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli, then uipro init --ai plus your app, as the README shows.
Ask, for example: design a landing page for a dental clinic.

name: playwright
d: Automates a browser: click, fill, screenshot.
plain: Lets Codex open websites, click, fill forms and take screenshots for you.
useFor: Take screenshots of a web page
Fill out a web form automatically
Check that your site's pages load correctly
steps: Open Codex and run: $skill-installer playwright
Restart Codex so it picks up the new skill.
Ask, for example: open example.com and take a screenshot.

name: gh-fix-ci
d: Finds and fixes failing GitHub Actions checks.
plain: Lets Codex find out why automatic checks on your GitHub project fail, and fix them.
useFor: Find why a GitHub check turned red
Get a fix for a failing check
Get an explanation of a failure log in plain words
steps: Open Codex and run: $skill-installer gh-fix-ci
Restart Codex so it picks up the new skill.
Open your project in Codex and ask: why are the checks failing on my pull request?

name: security-threat-model
d: Builds a threat model for your project.
plain: Lets Codex list the ways your project could be attacked and how to protect it.
useFor: List security risks in your app before launch
Decide which risks to fix first
Write a short security summary for your team
steps: Open Codex and run: $skill-installer security-threat-model
Restart Codex so it picks up the new skill.
Open your project in Codex and ask: build a threat model for this app.

name: vercel-deploy
d: Ships your site online in one step (Netlify and Cloudflare versions too).
plain: Lets Codex put your website online for you in one step.
useFor: Publish a site you built so others can visit it
Share a preview link of your project
Put a new version of your site online
steps: Open Codex and run: $skill-installer vercel-deploy
Restart Codex so it picks up the new skill.
Open your project in Codex and ask: deploy this site to Vercel.

name: Superpowers
d: The most-starred skills pack: brainstorm, plan, TDD, debug. Makes the agent work like a senior engineer.
plain: A set of skills that makes your coding AI plan, test and fix problems more carefully.
useFor: Brainstorm and plan a feature before any code
Have the AI test its work as it builds
Track down a bug step by step
steps: In Claude Code run: /plugin install superpowers@claude-plugins-official
In the Codex app click Plugins in the sidebar, find Superpowers, and click +.
For other apps, follow the install section of the README.
Describe what you want to build; the skills guide the steps.

name: Agent Skills
d: Production engineering habits: spec, plan, test, review, ship.
plain: A set of skills that makes your coding AI plan, test, review and ship like a careful engineer.
useFor: Write a short spec before building a feature
Get a code review before you publish
Run a checklist before launching your app
steps: For most AI coding apps run: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills
In Claude Code you can instead run /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills
Then run /plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills
Ask for the task, for example: review my changes before I publish.

name: anthropics/skills
d: Anthropic's official skills repo and plugin marketplace.
plain: Anthropic's official skills for Word, Excel, slides, PDFs, design and more, in one place.
useFor: Create Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files
Design posters and web pages
Start your own skill from a working example
steps: On a paid Claude plan these skills are already built into claude.ai and the desktop app.
In Claude Code run: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
Then /plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills or example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills.
Ask for the task in plain words, for example: make a Word report from these notes.

name: Claude plugins (official)
d: The official Claude Code plugin marketplace.
plain: Anthropic's official store of add-ons for Claude Code, from Anthropic and partner companies.
useFor: Browse add-ons that extend Claude Code
Install a partner's connector in one command
Find skill packs like Superpowers
steps: In Claude Code, type /plugin and open Discover to browse.
Or install directly: /plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-plugins-official
Check you trust a plugin before installing it; Anthropic does not vouch for third-party ones.

name: openai/plugins
d: Where OpenAI's Codex skills live now (openai/skills is deprecated).
plain: OpenAI's official collection of Codex add-ons, where its skills now live.
useFor: Browse official add-ons for Codex
Add skills for building web or mobile apps
Connect Codex to tools like Figma or Notion
steps: In the Codex app, click Plugins in the sidebar and browse.
In the Codex command line, type /plugins and search by name.
Pick a plugin and choose install, then ask for the task in plain words.

name: MCP reference servers
d: Reference MCP servers from the protocol maintainers.
plain: The official example connectors that let AI use files, memory, websites and other tools.
useFor: Let your AI read files in a folder
Give your AI memory between chats
Try a simple connector before bigger ones
steps: Install Node.js from nodejs.org; some servers need Python and uv instead.
Pick a server from the README, such as Filesystem or Memory.
Use the MCP setup page on this site to copy the config, then restart your app.

name: awesome-mcp-servers
d: The biggest curated list of MCP servers.
plain: A large community list of connectors that let AI use other apps and services.
useFor: Find a connector for an app you already use
Compare several connectors for the same service
Discover new things your AI can connect to
steps: Open the list on GitHub and browse by category.
Open a server's page and read its setup steps.
Add it with the MCP setup page on this site, or as its README says.

name: awesome-claude-code
d: Curated Claude Code skills, hooks, commands and workflows.
plain: A community list of add-ons, skills, commands and workflows for Claude Code.
useFor: Find add-ons others use with Claude Code
Discover time-saving commands and workflows
Get ideas for setting up your own Claude Code
steps: Open the list on GitHub and browse by section.
Open an item's own page and follow its install steps.
Install only items from sources you trust.

name: awesome-claude-skills
d: Curated list of Claude skills and resources.
plain: A community list of ready-made skills and guides for Claude.
useFor: Find a skill for a task you repeat
See examples of what skills can do
Learn how others write their own skills
steps: Open the list on GitHub and browse by category.
Open a skill's page and follow its install steps.
In the Claude apps, upload skill .zip files under Settings > Capabilities > Skills.
